name: ZipRecruiter
tagline: ZipRecruiter is an AI-powered job marketplace that distributes job postings to 100+ job boards simultaneously and uses machine learning to identify the most qualified candidates from applicants. Its 'Invite to Apply' feature proactively reaches passive candidates who match a role's requirements. Over 1.8 million businesses have used ZipRecruiter to fill positions faster than posting to a single job board.
